family: improvement-campaign mechanics (target-mask + conditioning, affine correction, transport decomposition, J-structure, span overlap)

figures.finding: Swapping the Jacobian's target mask moves ONLY the image rows: relative Frobenius 24.5 -> 255 (L0 -> L30) with cosine collapsing 0.39 -> 0.09, while text rows sit at the TF32 run-to-run noise floor (1.4e-2 -> 1.8e-6; the torch.equal hard criterion failed by construction, D36). X7: all 30 two-column swap bases are well-conditioned (cond 1.12-2.89, degenerate=false everywhere), 346x below the 1e3 exclusion threshold.

Affine correction does the early work, transport does the late work: bias+scale+clamp collapses the L20 bump (mean rank 2753 -> 811) and fixes the L0 bias blow-up (30.1k -> 1.98k), lifting LQS -0.102 -> +0.766; under the SAME payload the J transport is score-equal to identity at L0-7 (|ln ratio| <= 0.09), worth -0.05..-0.13 at L8-16, peaks -0.10..-0.25 at L17-28, and -0.508 at L30 (rank 127.7 -> 76.9).

The average Jacobian changes character with depth: alpha_ls = trace(J)/d rises from 0.046 at L0 and crosses 1 in the L20-23 band (peak 1.043 at L25) - the late map is identity-like - while the early J concentrates 87.5% of its energy in the top-64 (mostly off-diagonal) singular directions with a 1.41 symmetry ratio; by L30 the top-64 energy is 9.9%, symmetry 0.51 and the diagonal carries 0.04-5.3% of the Frobenius mass across depth.

Why J-lens edits need big alphas: the J's top-64 right-singular directions carry only 3.5-10.6% energy in W_U's readout span (chance 3.1%), so ~10-30x the residual-level magnitude is needed to move logits (D39's alpha 5-14x; x9b add@L16 alpha~27 changes 82% of generations). Their cross-layer overlap with the final layer is at chance (<=0.012) until L16, then 0.018-0.050 at L20-26 = 75-200x chance (1/4096) - the covariance drift the tuned lens exploits.

notes: All plotted numbers are read from the raw JSONs at run time; the 1e3 exclusion threshold lives in code/x7_x9_interventions.py (--cond-max) and the alpha~=27 (x9b k=1) reading exists only in DECISIONS.md D40, cited on the figures.

X1 'text rows bit-identical' wording: the JSON records text_rows_bit_identical=false; D36 adjudicates the residual (relFro 1.4e-2 -> 1.8e-6) as the X6-era TF32/atomics run-to-run noise floor, and the pre-registered torch.equal criterion as mis-calibrated (two separate fit invocations).
